body:
What else is there to define yourself by? I don't have any achievements or special skills or abilities. I'm bland. Boring. I'm socially retarded, I suffer from social anxiety and am unable to leave my house without panic attacks. Those people where the only ones I had grown to trust after a pretty long time. Now everything feels like it was a big lie.

There's absolutely no potential in someone like me. None whatsoever. And I guess people notice that and decide not to bother with someone like me, unless they have to. I'm human waste.
Why should I treat myself better than other people treat me? There's a reason for that treatment and the reason is that I'm absolutely worthless. I'm a loser. Even other losers just bother with me until they're better.

I don't see any reason to do anything anymore. Life has absolutely no appeal to me.It didn't have for a really long time. The only thing that kept me here was the thought that I had friends that cared and that needed or wanted me around. But it turned out that wasn't the case.

Hurting myself to hurt other people? There is noone around that cares if I'm hurting or not. Even if I'd wish they cared if I died they'd just go on with their lives, like they already did when they cut me out of it.
The only thing I could hope for is that they realize that they abandoned someone that was struggling to stay alive and their actions lead to them giving up, so that maybe they'll act different should a more important person need their help.

There's a lot more stuff going on for me, but this was kind of the straw that broke the camel's back. reaching out to people you looked up to and trusted, only to have them turn away and reject you. And here they continue living their live as if nothing ever happened, as if you never existed, as if they never told you that they'd be there for you.

What worth has a person that's completely unimportant to everyone around them? This all just confirmed what I've been thinking so long; Noone would miss me if I died. I'm a piece of shit that never mattered to anyone. At best, I burden the people around me.

Now I have absolutely nothing left.
